en: A black‑and‑white historic view of an elegant riverside boulevard in a European spa town. A row of richly decorated late‑19th‑century buildings lines the embankment; one corner building bears the large sign "KAISERHOF" on its roofline and several other German inscriptions on the façade. A tree‑lined promenade runs along a high stone river wall, with pedestrians strolling. In the foreground a bridge with ornate railings crosses a narrow river or canal; people and a horse‑drawn carriage move across the street. Hills with more buildings and trees rise in the background.
